test_title: SSC Stenographer 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 12 Oct, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

A few boys were __kept up__ because of disobedience.
solution: The correct answer is **"Option 3"**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The correct phrase to be substituted in the above sentence is** "kept back"**. • The subject of the sentence is **"a few boys."** and the verb** "were kept**" is in the **past tense.** • **"Were"** is the past tense form of the verb **"to be,"** and** "kept"** is the past tense form of the verb **"keep."** • In the context of the sentence, **"kept back"** implies a form of discipline where the boys are being restricted from freely moving or participation. (अनुशासन का एक रूप जहां लड़कों को स्वतंत्र रूप से घूमने या भाग लेने से प्रतिबंधित किया जा रहा है) • **Example**: *He kept back half the money for himself.* • Hence, **"kept back"** is the correct phrase to be substituted. Therefore, the correct answer is **"Option 3".** **Correct Sentence**: "A few boys were **kept back**__ because of disobedience." [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **"kept off"** is incorrect because it means to be prevented from doing something or staying somewhere.(कुछ करने या कहीं रहने से रोका जाना।) • **"kept on" **is incorrect because it means to continue doing something.(कुछ न कुछ करते रहना) • **"kept in"** is incorrect because it means to be confined or restricted to a particular place.(किसी स्थान विशेष तक सीमित या प्रतिबंधित होना।) 133:Td02, The correct answer is **"Option 3"**.
